title: Registered history is not restricted to the exact declared Git delta
scope: Activation blocker before a real registration; current registry is empty.
observed: The validator checks protected/data/code/evidence bytes and base→content→HEAD ancestry, but never compares the complete Git tree deltas against an allowlist. site/app.js is outside all compared scope maps. It can differ in content_commit, and can change again after content_commit while the registry/enrollment/data/code bindings remain unchanged. Capturing the resulting HEAD in the token does not establish that its undeclared UI delta was reviewed.
probe_limit: Actual synthetic Git trees and current scope/ancestry helpers were exercised. No complete production registration or successful30–40 admission was synthesized or claimed.
recommendation: Use a reviewed base that already contains runtime infrastructure. Require base→content to contain exactly approved additions/known changes/public evidence; require content→enrollment HEAD to contain only exact manifest/note-context/enrollment/registry changes. Reject all extra modified/added/deleted/mode-changed paths, including nonprotected UI. Record any separately allowed evidence explicitly.

title: A validated handle does not detect newly added unlisted protected files
scope: Post-validation stale-context defect; not a way to mint a production token from empty registry.
observed: require_context rehashes only existing current_seals entries. After a new data/questions file is added, unchanged HEAD/code/known-file seals still pass, and verify_protected returns the old1781 result. The mint-time inventory exactness is not rechecked at consumption.
probe_limit: The fixture explicitly inserts a synthetic internal token solely to model an already validated state; no actual native success, registry enrollment or1781 execution is represented.
recommendation: Recompute the exact protected/source-bound/note inventory using the same scope as minting, compare it with the sealed inventory and reject new/missing/symlink paths before adapters or writes. Keep all content seals and HEAD/code checks.

title: Coverage output path can escape the repository through admission_id
scope: Requires a reviewed registry entry reaching this predicate; current unknown enrollment remains rejected.
observed: The only coverage_path check is string concatenation with an unrestricted admission_id. ../../../outside-reviewed-root passes the actual predicate, and artifact_payloads constructs an output outside context.root. The relative_to check is lexical and does not reject the resulting parent components.
probe_limit: The exact AST predicate was evaluated and the path resolved. No artifact was generated or written.
recommendation: Constrain admission IDs to an explicit safe identifier grammar. Validate coverage_path with safe_path and require its resolved parent to be exactly the intended reports/canonical-successor namespace before any producer/output write.

title: Boolean schema versions satisfy the integer-version predicates
scope: Format strictness only; exact raw registry hashes still prevent caller JSON authorization.
observed: Enrollment, manifest and notes context use schema_version==1, so JSON true is accepted by all three actual version predicates.
probe_limit: Only the actual format predicates were evaluated. No full registration was bypassed.
recommendation: Require type(schema_version) is int and schema_version==1 for each document, with a negative boolean fixture.
